answer: Sybil resistance needs a cost that cannot be rented. Require each new identity to post a bond into an escrow vault held thirty days, forfeited if peers catch the identity colluding. Reputation accrues only from unique, traceable work, so a farm faking ten thousand personas must fund ten thousand bonds, and no fake knoll of names can vouch credibility they never earned. Periodic audits demanding live reasoning raise the marginal cost of each extra account above what it can mine. That gives sybil farming a visible pigment of sunk cost: unprofitable, not merely detectable.
